issues.on_page: p8 'Property and motor vehicle' 1,009,155 (General 989,060, Street 20,095); p14 General Fund budget schedule prints the same 989,060 as 'Property and motor vehicle'; p22 combining schedule prints it as 'Property'
issues.issue: The split does not separate motor vehicle tax from property tax; it only reclassifies the whole combined line as property tax by fund column. The report labels the identical General Fund 989,060 'Property and motor vehicle' on p8 and p14, so p22's 'Property' is not a breakdown by tax type. The 2026-11-06 ruling keeps combined property + motor vehicle rows as one row, 'Property Tax and Motor Vehicle Taxes'. Same applies to receipts[1].
